item.title: Wiggins makes 9-of-10 shots in 28-point outing to lead Heat over Grizzlies 136-120
item.description: Andrew Wiggins scored 28 points on 9-of-10 shooting, Norman Powell finished with 25 and the Miami Heat beat the Memphis Grizzlies 136-120 on Saturday night.

item.title: A long-acting HIV drug arrives in Zimbabwe for some at highest risk
item.description: Zimbabwe is one of the world's first countries to roll out lenacapavir, a long-acting HIV prevention drug that is administered only twice a year.

item.title: Kelvin Yeboah scores in 90th minute to rally Minnesota United to 2-2 draw with Austin in opener
item.description: Kelvin Yeboah scored in the 90th minute to rally Minnesota United to a 2-2 draw with Austin FC in a season opener.

item.title: Graham Ike scores 20 points to help No. 11 Gonzaga beat Pacific 71-62
item.description: Graham Ike had 20 points and three blocks, Davis Fogle scored 18 points and No. 11 Gonzaga beat Pacific 71-62 on Saturday night to wrap up a top-two seed and a semifinal spot in the WCC Tournament.

item.title: Desiree Wooten scores 19, Colorado women beat No. 20 Texas Tech 75-68
item.description: Desiree Wooten had 19 points, five rebounds and five assists to help Colorado beat No. 20 Texas Tech 75-68 to extend its win streak to five games.

item.title: Murphy, Freeman help Auburn end skid while dealing Kentucky third straight loss, 75-74
item.description: KeShawn Murphy totaled 25 points and 10 rebounds, and Elyjah Freeman tipped in a miss with 1.4 seconds left as Auburn ended a five-game losing streak by handing Kentucky a third straight loss, winning 75-74.

item.title: Agee, Griffen double up to seal Texas A&M's 75-71 win over Oklahoma
item.description: Rashaun Agee scored 18 points and Rylan Griffen scored 14 points and Texas A&M held on to beat struggling Oklahoma 75-71.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.

item.title: Stars descend on the BAFTA film awards, with 'One Battle' and 'Sinners' leading the race
item.description: The BAFTA Film Awards have a tight race, with "One Battle After Another" and "Sinners" leading the nominations.

item.title: Leo Messi and MLS champs Inter Miami get trounced 3-0 by Denis Bouanga and LAFC in season opener
item.description: Lionel Messi and Inter Miami got off to a rough start in their MLS Cup title defense when David Martínez, Denis Bouanga and Nathan Ordaz scored in Los Angeles FC's 3-0 victory.
